tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'phags pa dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// sgrub thabs brgya rtsa las byung ba// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī dzambha la sya saṃ kṣīpta sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal gnod gnas kyi mdor bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal gnod gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// sngar bstan pa'i cho gas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ gnyis pa'i gsum pa'i sa

dzam̐ bon ni mdog ser ba stong pa'i lhas mnan pa/ zla ba phyed pas rnam par brgyan pa/ de nyid las rdzogs pa'i dpal gnod gnas kha dog ser po/ phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa'i phyag na bī dza pū ra kaṃ /g.yon pa'i phyag na rin po che'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung gi tshogs dang padma'i tshogs kyi gter chen po mnan pa/ utpa la sngon po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dzambha la'i gzugs su bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ /rang gi khyim du yang rin po che sna tshogs la sogs pa'i char rab tu 'bab par 'gyur bar bdag nyid bsam par bya'o// de nas phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te/ gung mo dag gi dbus ma'i tshigs gsum pa bkug pa ni dzambha la'i phyag rgya'o// oṃ dzambha la dza lend+rā ya swā hā/ sngags 'di nyid kyis rje btsun la chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o// phyi nas mchod par byas te sngags bzla bar bya'o// de nas dngos grub ni sbyin bdag chen por 'gyur ro// the tshom med do// dpal gnod gnas kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /dpal gnod gnas kyi sgrub thabs la/ 'di la gnod gnas kyi rigs su skyes pas gnod gnas zhes bya'o// de sa bcu'i byang sems/ bcom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa la bdud kyis ri bsnyil bas/ gang ba bzang po dang gnod gnas gnyis kyis sku g.yogs pas/ gang ba bzang po la rdo leb phog pas shi ste/ gnod gnas kyi dbu la'ang rdo yar gcig phog pas bsnad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i bstan pa la zhugs pa rnams khyod la rma 'khrud par byed pa'i chu sbyin du gzhug gi/

khyod kyis kyang de dag la nor gyis phan thogs par gyis shig ces gsungs pas bka' dang lus srung ba dang nor 'dod pa rnams kyis mi byar mi rung ngo*// sgrub pa pos sems bskyed la/ snying gar pad zla la dzam̐ de'i 'od kyis rten spyan drangs la tshogs gnyis bsag go /de nas lus sgyu ma tsam gyi snying gar pad zla'i steng du gnyis pa'i gsum pa dza/ de la thig le yod pa ni stong pa'i lhas mnan pa'i zla phyed dang bcas pa ste dzam̐ mo// de'i 'od kyis dpal gnod gnas spyan drangs te de nyid la thim pa de gyur pa las dpal gnod gnas ser po phyag g.yas khru gang pa'i shing thog ser po bsnams pa/ bī dza pū ra kaṃ mo// chu ster ba na shing thog de'i nang nas bdud rtsi 'bab par bsam mo// rin chen 'byung gnas kyis gtso byas pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan no// bum pa gnyis na dung g.yas su 'khyil pa dang ratna padma rā ga bcug pa'i gter chen po zhabs kyis mnan pa/ utpa la sngon po'i do shal can/ ratna du mas brgyan pa/ bag tsam g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ngo*// rang gi skyes pa'i khyim mam rang 'dug pa'i khyim du ratna'i char babs par bsam mo// man ngag nyid yin te 'dug sa btsan par byas na bde gsungs/ bsgoms pas skyo na/ phyag rgya bcings la sngags bzlas te gzhan dang mthun no// ldang ba na yi ge brgya pa brjod pa la sogs pa bya'o// 'di la chu sbyin pa'i thabs ni sems bskyed la/ skad cig gis bsam pa'am/ spro bsdu sngar bzhin dzam̐ lhar bskyed pa/ mdun gyi rdzing bu'i nang du skad cig gis dzam̐ lhar bskyed la/ rang gi sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs bstims la/ g.yon pas phreng ba bgrang zhing g.yas pas ser mo brkyangs shing gcig nas bdud rtsi 'bab par bsams la/ chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dbul lo// de nas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsol cig dang*/ dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod cig ces pa'i gsol ba gdab/

bstod pa bya/ ye shes pa badzra muḥs gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// lugs sku yod na dam tshig pa mi dgos/ de rang la ye shes pa bstim/ ma bstim kyang chog gsungs// / bla ma sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dzambha la ser po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas te/ rang gi snying gar sna tshogs padma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ dzam̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab ste/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang rnam smin gyi lus stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarpabadharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las dzam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa dzambha la sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang padma'i gter mnan pa/ utpa la sngon po'i phreng ba dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su dzam̐ yig ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dzambha la'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i dzam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba la sems gtad cing*/

sku'i cha shas thams cad las rin po che'i char babs pas/ rang gi gnas khang thams cad khengs shing sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal thams cad bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la gdan rnams rang la bsdus te/ dge rtsa bsngo'o// chu sbyin byed par spro na/ snod kyi nang du pad zla la dzam̐ yig las dzambha la gong ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ gong gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu phul/ oṃ ārya dzambha la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ dzambha la siddhi pha la hoḥ dngos grub kyi bsam pas chu cung zad lce thog tu bzhag la/ mdun gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o// rjes gnang byed na mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ tshom bu lhar bskyed/ mchod bstod/ gtor ma a kā ro'i sngags kyis phul te/ bzlas pa bya/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags pa dzambha la'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams lan gsum gsum dang gzhi dgod pa'i phyir du slob ma la bskyed bstim bya/ rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du rigs 'dra ba stim/ gtso bos sogs 'dra/ rjes mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdus la bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di yang don du gnyer ba 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir du shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
